commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+4' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
90+1' The attendance is 23613.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
88' Some patient build-up play from Oviedo as they look to unlock the defence.
86' Substitution. Federico Vinas is replaced by Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo).
85' Celta Vigo concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.

53' A player from Celta Vigo commits a rough challenge. Francisco Maeso blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
51' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
50' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.
50' A cross into the box from Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
48' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

42' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

38' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:1.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.
34' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Celta Vigo players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
30' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:1.

19' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

16' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
14' The possession of the ball – 49:51.

7' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
5' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
3' Oviedo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
